title: Outperforming 1000 Euclidean Layers With Hyperbolic Goal-Conditioned RL
abstract: arXiv:2610.20009v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scaling self-supervised contrastive reinforcement learning (CRL) to 1000-layer Euclidean neural networks has enabled state-of-the-art goal-reaching performance, yet wall-clock time scales linearly with depth. We find that changing the geometry achieves stronger performance with far shallower networks. This matters in complex navigation environments, where walls can make route distance deviate substantially from Euclidean distance. In a U-shaped maze, we show that the longer the route, the more it deviates from Euclidean distance. Hyperbolic CRL addresses this mismatch by replacing Euclidean distances in CRL's contrastive objective with geodesic distances in hyperbolic space. On hard navigation tasks, inductive bias beats scale: depth 64 hyperbolic agents outperform 1024-layer-deep Euclidean networks while training more than $12 \times$ faster and using about $13 \times$ fewer parameters. translated_title: 使用双曲目标条件强化学习超越1000层欧几里得网络
translated_abstract: 将自监督对比强化学习（CRL）扩展到1000层欧几里得神经网络已经实现了最先进的目标达成性能，但其实际运行时间随深度线性增长。我们发现，改变几何结构可以用浅得多的网络实现更强的性能。这在复杂导航环境中尤为重要，因为墙壁会使路径距离与欧几里得距离产生显著偏差。在U形迷宫中，我们证明了路径越长，其与欧几里得距离的偏差就越大。双曲CRL通过将CRL对比目标中的欧几里得距离替换为双曲空间中的测地距离来解决这种不匹配问题。在困难导航任务上，归纳偏置胜过规模：深度为64的双曲智能体超越了1024层深的欧几里得网络，同时训练速度快12倍以上，参数量少约13倍。我们观察到双曲智能体的行为在质上……
tldr: 通过将对比强化学习中的欧几里得距离替换为双曲空间的测地距离，仅64层深的双曲智能体就能以超过12倍的训练速度和约13倍的参数量优势，超越1024层欧几里得网络的导航性能。
